name: Austin Wingate
fact: Ran for SGA president in the spring of 2012 in a three-way race against Cory Dodds and Corey Johnson, after his year as Speaker of the Student Senate. Dodds won. The 2013 Talisman also carries a feature on him, 'A Vote for Support' by Allyson Beasecker.

name: Lisa M. Kappler
fact: Resigned as Chief Justice of the Judicial Council during 2008-09; the Herald reported it on 17 February 2009. Corey Bewley, listed in the worklist as the successor Chief Justice, was approved two days later, reported 19 February 2009. The worklist records Kappler as Clerk of the Judicial Council, which the Herald contradicts by calling her chief justice.
